# Platform

> Self-hosted Kubernetes PaaS control plane: deploy, secrets, databases, observability, SDKs, and MCP for AI agents.

Site: https://platform.pratyushes.dev
Docs (HTML): https://platform.pratyushes.dev/docs
Docs (Markdown corpus): https://platform.pratyushes.dev/docs/
Full agent index: https://platform.pratyushes.dev/llms-full.txt
Sitemap: https://platform.pratyushes.dev/sitemap.xml
Source: https://github.com/Mpratyush54/SERVER-automation

## Start here

- [Landing](https://platform.pratyushes.dev/landing): product overview
- [Docs home](https://platform.pratyushes.dev/docs): documentation index ([Markdown](https://platform.pratyushes.dev/docs/index.md))
- [Installation](https://platform.pratyushes.dev/docs/getting-started/installation): install Platform ([Markdown](https://platform.pratyushes.dev/docs/getting-started/installation.md))
- [platformctl CLI](https://platform.pratyushes.dev/docs/getting-started/platformctl): CLI reference ([Markdown](https://platform.pratyushes.dev/docs/getting-started/platformctl.md))

## Optional live API (when deployed on an app host)

- OpenAPI JSON: `GET /api/openapi.json` (not served as marketing content on this host)

## Crawl notes

- Public host serves marketing + docs only.
- Cache-friendly: `/`, `/landing`, `/docs*`, `/docs/**/*.md`, static logos/favicons.
- Do not treat authenticated app routes as public content.
